hash_4fee68363c1bea97: We are searching for strong candidates to test our developing armor project. We require not only physical fitness, but also mental fortitude and quickness. While the alloy is remarkably light for its level of protection, a level of strength is still required to comfortably maneuver through a battlefield. The integrated cybernetic aspects will require a level of focus as well as quick-thinking in order to utilize any connected equipment in a fast-paced combat environment. Intelligent candidates who understand the science as technically as possible will adapt more easily, while providing more specific and actionable feedback. If any soldiers under your command meet these criteria, send their names to our development team immediately.
hash_4fee69363c1bec4a: All Shadows - intel suggests Konni was unable to access the bunker. Entry is not a priority at this time. Primary objective still stands: contain and clear all threats on the island.
hash_4fee6a363c1bedfd:
The short-term effects of the Rapid-Acting General Enhancement formula remain consistent: Exhausted soldiers become alert and effective immediately. We have successfully concentrated the product past the required threshold, increasing the effective range of a single aerosol deployment for application on entire squads.

Without more time for testing, it's impossible to predict long-term effects of the modifications, but every loyal soldier here should be willing to take that risk.

Recommendation: Increase production. Distribute immediately.
hash_4fee63363c1be218: NOTICE: Power is being routed from low-priority operations to accommodate increased needs of production facilities until further notice. In case of emergency, energy flow willl default and must be rerouted via manual override as soon as possible.
hash_4fee64363c1be3cb: Maintenance checks on biometric scanners have not returned any technical malfunctions. These infrequent reports must just be anomalies within the system. Without any sort of enemy presence detected on or around the island, there is no reason to suspect interference.
hash_4fee65363c1be57e: Final swarm protocol tests have proven successful. Drones are now capable of moving as integrated, cohesive units.Begin packaging and delivery of drones to other operations.
hash_4fee66363c1be731: As multiple projects approach completion, we have instituted a new security lockdown protocol. Detection of any disruption across island operations will engage total lockdown of the holding case, requiring manual override input on the keypad. Only those with the highest clearance will have the code required for access. False alarms may create a minor inconvenience, but security of this equipment is of the utmost importance. Do not let our hard work fall into the hands of our enemies.

hash_54b90ebcf990b37d: Enjoy a high-level keycard, courtesy of the enemy. This is just the beginning. We're going to make them pay... Literally.
hash_54b90dbcf990b1ca: Update complete. I've granted you access to my old base. You'll find a device there that should help you out. Make them regret ever setting foot on Rebirth.
hash_54b90cbcf990b017: The updated device will now funnel enemy assets directly into your pocket. We're using their own resources against them.
hash_54b90bbcf990ae64: I cracked syphoning from contracts a long time ago, but this new protocol is a step up. We're not limited to cash anymore.
hash_54b90abcf990acb1: Everyone hacks contracts now. You can thank the tech shared when Vondel needed defending from hostile invaders... Sound familiar?
hash_54b909bcf990aafe: This isn't the first time I've shared tech with operatives. Even left scanners behind in Vondel to test potential recruits.
hash_54b908bcf990a94b: Nobody saw the Vondel attack coming. Lesson learned. I knew Rebirth couldn't last forever and had backups ready.
hash_54b907bcf990a798: Places like Rebirth, they draw conflict, like combat magnetism. It's cyclical, the fighting always rolls back around. History repeats.
hash_54b906bcf990a5e5: Impressed by your dedication. Fight after fight, you've earned these access boosts. Definite potential for something bigger.
hash_54b905bcf990a432: People try to preserve the past, but sometimes it's better to blow it all up and move on. Don't worry, I'd warn you before triggering the self-destruct sequence.
hash_54bc74bcf99396a6: Left my old base behind without a second thought. That's the advantage of being digital: Can be everywhere and nowhere.
hash_54bc75bcf9939859: Abandoning my base might seem like a loss, but with that device in your hands, I've got a knight among pawns. Chess, not checkers.
hash_54bc72bcf9939340: It's important to stay agile, always moving. Rebirth wasn't my only hideout. I'm not stranded with a laptop on coffee shop wifi.
hash_54bc73bcf99394f3: Will be checking in less frequently. Got other projects. Heading to clean up some unfinished business elsewhere.
hash_54bc78bcf9939d72: You're a good soldier, a worthy ally. Let's hope our interests stay aligned. Our paths may cross again in the future.
hash_5593c28de577c38e: Update requires restart. Just kidding. Enjoy your keycard.
hash_54bffcbcf996b395: Why trust the ghost in the machine? I can ensure you get a good keycard. Call it a sign of good faith.

hash_54bff6bcf996a963: Listen, I can augment your access level. So put in maximum effort and get sweaty out there, okay?
hash_54bff5bcf996a7b0: Hacking these scanners was easy, but there's still a treasure trove of info to uncover. Just need some time... Stay tuned.
hash_54bff8bcf996acc9: I'm inside the system, boosting your access level, while you're out there cleaning up the island. We actually make a good team.
hash_54bff7bcf996ab16: Rebirth was serene before the invading high-tech home makeover project. Glad those airstrikes are tearing it back down.
